enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Potency +80: Passive: +80 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Impulse +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Evocation Focus III: +3 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Enchantment Focus III: +3 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by two.
Spell Lore VI: Passive: All of your spells gain a 6% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.

children.tooltip: Planar Conflux: When this item is equipped at the same time as a Planar Focus, you will gain set bonuses based on the Planar Focus that you have equipped.
+7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.+8 Enhancement Bonus: +8 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

children.text: Adds a choice of one of the following:

children.tooltip: Combustion +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power.
Glaciation +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Corrosion +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Acid Spell Power.
Magnetism +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Nullification +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Devotion +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Radiance +120: Passive: +120 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
